entries.defect: VERIFIED: skeleton.py:13-14 gives hips and spine the SAME head and tail (joint-pelvis → joint-spine-2), :64 sums MakeHuman spine_01 and spine_02 into one bone and :72 drops UAL1 DEF-spine.002; the measured spine channel is zero in every retargeted clip (walk, sprint, idle, kneel*, carry; only the authored dig writes it). The trunk therefore has TWO pivots (pelvis, spine-2), and the hips cannot carry a lean share without tipping the legs. KEPT over B2's 'no new bones': a three-segment spine (spine at the lumbar joint, spine1, chest; MH spine_01/02/03 and UAL1 DEF-spine.001/.002/.003 mapped 1:1, UAL2 spine_01..03) is the ONE topology change, 21 → 22 bones, because final state 6 asks for a lean distributed over hips, spine and chest and distribution over two co-located pivots cannot produce a curve — this is exactly B2's own precondition, 'a demonstrated deformation failure redistribution cannot solve', met by measurement. B2's safeguards become its acceptance: axes, bind matrices and normalized weights checked, dress layers rebuilt, glTF export and low preset unchanged, penetration gate (U1 scope) green on both backends before anything downstream lands.

VERIFIED: the GLB carries grip.L/R morphs and the dig clip asks for both at 1 (toolclips.py:359-361); bakeMorphs keeps them as live morphs (villagerBody.ts:55-82) but the hang bake then sets g.morphAttributes = {} (villagerFigureBody.ts:112) and no runtime path applies clip.grip — the fingers stay splayed in every drawn frame, including around the shovel. KEPT (B2 first, then A5): carry the live hand morphs through the hang bake (deltas through the same linear skin map, zero deltas for garment vertices), drive their weights from the action state (dig/carry grip, point), then add a point.L/R shape (index out, others curled) and a relax shape for the resting hand beside grip.L/R, built from the MH finger weights as grip_shape is. No finger bones (both halves agree). B2's 'keep 21 deform joints' clause loses to U2 for the spine alone and holds everywhere else.

CONDITIONAL, after U2/U3 and the first U1 runtime sheet. A4's wrist-wringing diagnosis rests on the dig sheet, whose hands are the splayed rest hand with the grip morph dead (U3) and whose arms are folded onto the shaft by the extra-lean search (U7); it is not yet shown that a forearm twist bone, rather than the fixed hand and the missing grip, is the cause. DECIDED by B2's rule: add forearmTwist.L/R (distal half of the forearm, ~50 % of the hand's roll, weights split from the MH forearm by distance) only if the dig and point runtime sheets still show the wrist wringing once U3 and U7 are in; then it is a second rig change under the same penetration gate (sleeves at the wrist). Upper-arm and thigh twist are not proposed.

entries.defect: VERIFIED: the pinned UAL1 snapshot (CC0, sha256 recorded) holds Jog_Fwd_Loop, PickUp_Table, Interact and Idle_Talking_Loop unused; clips.py:26-31 takes idle, walk, sprint and Fixing_Kneeling only; UAL2_Standard.glb and its licence file lie in local/assets-src/villager/quaternius (Walk_Carry_Loop, Farm_Harvest, Farm_PlantSeed, OverhandThrow, UE bone names pelvis/spine_01..03/clavicle_*/ball_*), pinned at 98069fa23 and removed from sources.json at 74ff3d00d; the walk's natural speed is 0.834 and the sprint's 6.014 person units/s (7.2×), cross-faded directly over sprintThreshold 1.8 ± 0.35 with a geometric contact fraction of 12 %/7 % per foot and 81 % of samples with no contact; close_loop smears a ~1 rad sprint seam over the whole cycle. KEPT: re-pin UAL2 with its licence and sha256 and add MAPS['UAL2']; retarget Jog_Fwd_Loop as `jog` and make gaitAt a three-way walk → jog → sprint blend by speed (jogThreshold/sprintThreshold bands in balance.ts, all three rotated to left-heel-strike phase 0); export per gait clip the heel/ball/toe CONTACT INTERVALS and the loop seam size as metadata, and refuse (print and fail) a seam above a calibratable limit instead of smearing it. DECIDED: the pinned UAL1 snapshot stays (B3's own rule: never swap a pinned hash for an unversioned latest); a newer snapshot or Kenney is auditioned only if a clip proves unusable. CMU (not CC0), Mixamo, LAFAN1/Bandai (NC) and the Orange Duck data (NC-ND) are recorded in the research document as NOT usable under the CC0 constraint; there is no CC0 turn-on-the-spot, point or tag clip, so those stay procedural (U11, U14-U16). Starts/stops are the walk's own first/last cycle under the holds, not new clips.

VERIFIED from the GLB (local Euler, degrees): walk chest pitch 16.4/18.2/20.0 with neck −9 and head +6 (a hunched source), hands splayed, elbows ~40-60° and arms held forward in every walk frame of the tracked side sheet; sprint hips pitch 22.7 CONSTANT plus chest 25.7/31.5/38.5 and chest yaw ±27-29 (a ~50° dive); idle hips yaw −13.3 and head yaw +11.0 constant with a staggered stance (foot_L z +0.09, foot_R z −0.23). REFUTED and dropped from A8: 'the feet cross the midline' — the walk's ankles stay at x = +0.082..0.093 and −0.093..−0.082 for the whole cycle (constant stance width, no crossing), so no hip-abduction offset is added. KEPT: per-clip style offsets in the pipeline from VILLAGER_ASSET.clipStyle — walk chest −12°, arm hang closer to the body with 15-25° elbow; sprint hips pitch removed (kept as rest delta of the retarget), chest pitch scaled to 10-12° and yaw to ±12° (a child's run, the tag game's top pace); idle de-staggered (least-stagger frame or Idle_Talking_Loop blend) and its constant yaws removed. The idle matters at runtime only once U9 makes it the standing base; today the runtime reads walk, sprint, carry, carryIdle and dig only.

entries.file: scripts/villager/toolclips.py (DIG_KEYS, dig_clip); src/scenes/place/adultWork.ts, PlaceLife.tsx, gltfClipLayers.ts; src/render/gesture.ts (DIG_CYCLE_SECONDS)
entries.defect: VERIFIED: DIG_PERIOD is 2.4 s (toolclips.py:199) while adultWork.ts:307 counts strikes on DIG_CYCLE_SECONDS = 1.5 (gesture.ts:472), so the counted strike and the drawn stroke drift; the head is keyed at a fixed 0.12 rad (:311) and the clip's head channel is a constant 6.9°; the hands are solved onto the shaft by an extra-lean search of up to 0.9 rad (:328-331), which is why the quarter sheet shows the trunk folded down onto the upper hand at chin height; no foot presses the blade; knees track inward in the quarter sheet (pole straight ahead). REFUTED and dropped from A12: 'the shaft is held 25-35° from horizontal for most of the stroke and never goes near-vertical' — DIG_KEYS computes to 60° from horizontal at the set and push (t = 0, 0.45), 45° at 0.85 and 16-22° only at the lever and throw (1.30, 1.70), which is a lever. KEPT (B8's frame, A12's verified items inside it): keep the authored blade path and shaft-roll protection, give the stroke named phases (set, press, lever, lift/throw, recover) with ONE action clock shared by animation and progress and a strike EVENT at blade contact; solve both grips on the FINAL body of every corner (no fixed adult offsets), bound the extra-lean search so the trunk does not fold onto the hands (the distributed lean of U10 carries it), aim neck and head at the blade instead of the fixed 0.12, hands apart on the shaft, knee poles outward and an optional foot press on the tread at the set. Dig stays in the dressed poses, so the penetration gate covers it.

VERIFIED: clipGaitPose runs solveLimb on BOTH legs EVERY frame (:243) with a fixed person-space pole (0,0,1) (:242), so the clip's knee swivel and abduction are discarded; the stride warp (:179) shifts the foot's z by (stride − 1) and leaves the hips' height alone (stilt-lock at strideMax 1.35, crouch at strideMin 0.75); the foot keeps the clip's world rotation (:244) and the toe is never re-written by the solve; contacts are inferred from a height threshold (PLANT_TOUCH) each frame, held in x/z only (:45-47), and plantRelease (:224-229) deliberately moves a held anchor; the test skips the cross-fade band and allows 0.08 inside it (B measured 0.044 at the band midpoint against 0.0014 at the walk). KEPT, in this order: (1) pole from the clip's own knee (hip→knee minus its component along hip→ankle, blended to the forward pole as the leg straightens); (2) solve only when the held target misses the clip's ankle by more than a calibratable ~2 mm, otherwise the clip's leg is untouched; (3) pelvis height lowered to what the warped stride needs (as walkPose does) and back to clip height when not; (4) toe re-written at push-off so the ball stays flat while the heel rises; (5) contact state from the exported support intervals of U5 (the height threshold stays as a fallback), persistent per-contact anchors, pelvis adjustment bounded by leg reach; (6) the solve is the LAST pass after every layer (U9). DECIDED: the 1295 hold logic and plantRelease stay as the safety net; once the jog removes the walk↔sprint hybrid the test's band exemption is removed and the 0.004-per-frame limit applies across the whole speed ramp, both sexes, all ages and build extremes, at 30/60/120 Hz. Per-foot terrain height (B5) is DEFERRED to the backlog: PlaceLife places the group at the root's ground height, no in-game defect on slopes is measured, and final state 3 asks for placement correction, not terrain conforming.

VERIFIED: the gait layer blends LEGS (hips, legs, toes) and the free arms only (gltfClipLayers.ts:102,151-155); spine, chest, neck and head stay code-written (skinnedFigure.tsx:385-387, 452-453) so the clip's trunk counter-rotation and head never show; the code's hipYaw/chestYaw run on the code walk's m.phase while the legs run on the clip phase g.phase (two clocks, differing cycle lengths); spine.y −= walk.hipYaw compensates a hip yaw the gait layer has already overwritten (a stray ±4°); the clip arms were authored under an 18°-pitched chest and are blended as locals under the upright code chest; the contact arms (leanIn/solveTo) are solved BEFORE applyClipLayers (:508) moves the pelvis; the kneel clips are exported but the runtime uses the procedural kneelBlend. KEPT: ONE pose evaluator in a fixed order — full-body clip base (idle/walk/jog/sprint/kneel/dig incl. trunk, neck, head, clavicles) → masked action layers (carry arm, pick-up) → additive deltas (U10 lean and gaze, U13 shoulders, elder stoop, gesture turn) → contact solves (hands, then feet in U8) → hand shapes and props last. One gait clock: the code walk's counter-yaw and arm swing are dropped for the glTF body where the clip supplies them, m.phase stays only for the primitive figure and the plant bookkeeping; the stray −walk.hipYaw goes. The head reset by unsquashHead moves to the end and composes with the gaze (U10). Acceptance: with zero code lean the trunk bones equal the clip's; every contact Vitest and Playwright section (pounding, loom, fishing, hand on stone) stays green; the runtime sheet of U1 shows the composed walk.

entries.file: src/render/figureRig.ts, gesture.ts (FigurePose); src/scenes/place/skinnedFigure.tsx, PlaceLife.tsx, tagGame.ts; src/config/balance.ts
entries.defect: VERIFIED: every lean writes spine.rotation.x alone (skinnedFigure.tsx:452, contactLean figureRig.ts:107-121), which with U2's finding pivots at the pelvis so trunk, head and arms tip as one block; FigurePose has lean and turn but no gaze; unsquashHead sets head.quaternion to identity whenever the squash is 1 (figureRig.ts:154) and is called twice per frame (:513, :593), erasing any authored head rotation; chaserGaze turns the TRUNK (tagGame.ts:1265-1272). KEPT: one additive upper-body layer with two pure functions — distributeLean(pitch, yaw) over spine/spine1/chest (hips only where the legs are re-solved under it; weights in balance.ts, e.g. 0.3/0.3/0.4 pitch, no bone above 35 % of the total) replacing every single-joint lean (contactLean re-searched through the distributed chain so hands still land, the elder stoop, gesture lean, tag lean, caught slump), and aimHead(target | horizon) over chest (yaw share only) → neck 0.4 → head 0.6 with limits (yaw ±70°, pitch −40…+30°) and frame-rate-independent damping, defaulting to the horizon along the heading (head stabilisation under lean and bob) and fed by context: the speaker, the pointed spot, the blade, the hand in a contact, the quarry, the ground ahead for the slump; gaze and sway tightened under a head load. unsquashHead composes after it (it already keeps the twist). Vitest: 'lean is distributed', 'gaze hold' (head forward within 3° of the target under a 0.3 rad lean and a gait cycle).

entries.file: src/render/figureWalk.ts; src/render/villagerClipPose.ts; src/scenes/place/skinnedFigure.tsx, PlaceLife.tsx, tagGame.ts; src/config/balance.ts
entries.defect: VERIFIED: figureWalk.ts:446 turns a yaw change into forward-equivalent distance (walked = ahead ± (aside + turned·turnStep), turnStep 0.4 → a stationary quarter turn 'walks' 0.63 figure units), so a spot turn plays the forward walk in place against the holds until plantRelease lets them slip (B measured 0.013/frame at 90°/s); the whole figure yaws as one block (g.rotation.y = c.facing) with no head lead and no lean into the curve. KEPT: for the glTF body, travel, facing and turn phase are tracked separately; the gaze (U10) takes the steering's desired heading so the head leads; on the move a roll of the distributed chain proportional to yaw-rate × speed (curveLeanMax ~6°) and the inside stride shortened; at rest a PROCEDURAL STEP TURN — the body yaws in steps of ≤ 35°, the inner foot lifts (the walk's swing-phase foot shape played sideways) and plants at the new heading under the hip, the outer follows, held contacts pivot on the BALL (rotate the foot about its ball contact, not the ankle) — replacing the turned·turnStep distance; signed travel so a backward or sideways recovery is not a forward stride. DECIDED: procedural first, authored turn clips later only if the step turn does not read (no CC0 turn clip exists, Blender authoring is the costlier route); collision, steering and catch authority stay with the simulation. Vitest: a 180° spot turn takes 3-5 steps with no planted contact moving more than 1 mm; in-game picture of a villager turning to face the player.

CHECK, probably moot. VERIFIED: the walk clip already carries pelvic yaw ±2.0°, roll ±2.5°, lateral shift x −0.025..0.031 and a vertical bob of 0.043 person units, and the gait layer blends the clip's hips rotation and position (gltfClipLayers.ts:151-152) — so the pelvic secondary motion is present once U9 passes the trunk through. KEPT only as a check item: the U1 runtime front sheet is read for a static pelvis after U6/U9; a stance-side pelvis shift (±1.5 cm × legScale) is added only if it shows one, otherwise this item closes without code.

VERIFIED: UNWRITTEN = ['toe.L','toe.R','shoulder.L','shoulder.R'] resets the clavicles to identity before every blend (gltfClipLayers.ts:105,135) and no pose can protract or drop a shoulder — the caught child's rounded shoulders (final state 8) and the pointing clavicle (final state 7) are impossible today. KEPT: the clavicles leave UNWRITTEN (the clip's clavicle comes through U9), FigurePose gains a `shoulders` field (protraction and elevation per side, default 0) written as an additive after the clip, and clavicle poses enter the penetration pose list: the toga, cloak and cape deform with them, so the gate decides. Vitest: default 0 leaves the clip's clavicle untouched.

VERIFIED: point is armAim plus lean 0.04 (gesture.ts:412-415); the skinned adapter aims a straight virtual arm, fixes the forearm at −0.2 rad (skinnedFigure.tsx:499), resets the wrist to identity (:501), has no gaze and no finger shape; contact reaches use a fixed elbow pole and clamp nothing short of the straight arm. KEPT: pointing and contact reach are distinct intents. Point: gaze first (U10 targets the spot at t = 0), the arm envelope 0.15 s later, forearm near-straight (0-0.1 rad, short of the singular pose), the point hand shape (U3), the clavicle protracted ~0.1 rad (U13), the chest turned a quarter toward the target through the distributed yaw, the pointing line and chosen arm kept across a target crossing, the other arm free to swing while walking. Reach: hand position AND orientation solved after the final torso (U9 order), an action-specific stable elbow pole, torso within its permitted range or a step requested beyond reach, planted feet undisturbed. Vitest of the sequence timing and target grids at several heights, bearings and body sizes; point sheet; in-game talk picture.

entries.file: src/scenes/place/tagGame.ts (tagFigurePose, chaserGaze, CHASER_ARMS, steerGrab), PlaceLife.tsx; src/render/gesture.ts (TOUCH_LEAN); src/config/balance.ts
entries.defect: VERIFIED: the sprint's constant 22.7° hips pitch tips the whole chain, the tag game adds leanAtSprint 0.28 on spine (tagGame.ts:1183-1184) and tagFigurePose takes lean = max(runLean, shown.lean) with the touch gesture's TOUCH_LEAN 0.5 (:1538, gesture.ts:105,453) — up to ~50° from the pelvis; chaserGaze turns the trunk within gazeTurnMax 0.6, not the head; CHASER_ARMS holds BOTH arms forward (armAim ±0.2, −0.18), both count as contact arms in skinnedFigure (:376-382) so the run's arm swing is suppressed; steerGrab starts the touch at once and 'touch' has no fade-in (gesture.ts:93). KEPT: the chaser runs — pelvis and legs from the jog/sprint (U5/U6), the free arm keeps the clip's counter-swing; its lean is the run's only, ≤ 0.12 rad total and distributed (U10), TOUCH_LEAN no longer applies while running; the gaze sits on the quarry through U10 (head and neck, a 25 % chest share), the neck extended back against the remaining lean; as the quarry enters the commit window one arm blends from its swing into a bent-elbow preparation (a tag-own pre-aim, not a fade-in on 'touch', so the bank tap's no-fade-in rule is untouched), then reaches HORIZONTALLY at shoulder height with the elbow near-straight and the clavicle protracted, aligned at the authoritative catch frame to the actual target (the existing hand readback kept) and recovered after a miss; CHASER_ARMS with both arms forward goes. Numbers in balance.ts (chaserLeanMax, chaserReachElevation, prepare distance). Vitest: trunk pitch sum ≤ 0.15 rad, head forward within 5° of the quarry bearing inside the limits, reaching hand within 10° of horizontal; approach→catch and approach→miss trajectories; port-city picture on both backends, judged by looking.

VERIFIED: caughtSlumpPose is a symmetric 0.48 rad (27.5°) fold at the pelvis with the arms pitched −lean (tagGame.ts:1495-1504), balance.ts:1819 carries an // OPEN against the specified 0.20, the head is never posed and the clavicles are reset (U13); PlaceLife.tsx:1116-1118 describes it as 'trunk leaned forward, arms hanging plumb'; bankFigurePose already shares the pose with the bank round. KEPT: one definition for both tag and bank — a short brake-and-settle transition into a planted hold: trunk ~0.12 rad total over spine/spine1/chest only (hips 0, no fold), chest sunk, clavicles protracted ~0.25 rad and dropped ~0.1 (U13), head bowed ~0.35 rad by the gaze on the ground ~1 m ahead (U10), arms hanging by gravity in the chest frame plus 0.05-0.1 rad forward with a slight elbow bend, one knee softened and the weight shifted subtly to the other leg, a quiet hold (restrained breathing or a small weight shift, no sway of the contacts) and a blend back from that support state. balance.ts: caughtSlump {trunk, shoulderForward, shoulderDrop, headBow} replaces caughtSlumpLean/caughtSlumpArmRoll and closes that // OPEN. Vitest: hips pitch 0, trunk sum ≤ 0.15 rad, clavicle protraction > 0, no foot drift and no whole-body squash through catch→settle→hold→resume; river-bank picture on both backends at play distance (dejection, not a bow, an injury or a crouch).

entries.defect: VERIFIED: the game has ONE pick-up beat — the jar fill at the water: adultWork.ts:669-683 runs a fill phase and swaps emptyJar → fullJar at its end, PlaceLife.tsx:3116-3117 switches two prop visibilities and :3189-3194 y-squashes the WHOLE figure group for the dip (the head compensated, the limbs compressed); no pick-up clip is exported although UAL1 PickUp_Table and UAL2 Farm_Harvest are pinned or on disk; low contact reaches fold the back through contactLean and the kneelWork cut dives from the waist. KEPT (A11's clip, A24's layer, B9's phases): retarget PickUp_Table (table height) and Farm_Harvest (ground) and cut them down/hold/up as the kneel is; a `pickUp` work layer beside dig in gltfClipLayers (eased over transitionSeconds, no snap) with phases approach → reach → grasp → lift → place/release, the gaze on the object (U10), knees before back on low reaches (contactCrouch share in the distributed reach), the hand corrected to the object and closed at contact (U3), and ONE authoritative prop transform carried world → hand → crown with its world transform preserved on re-parenting (lift from the water, placement on the crown, then head carry); the y-squash is replaced by the clip's bone-driven squat on the glTF body (the primitive figure keeps it — U20); the water-mouth alignment and fill feedback stay; gameplay ownership changes at the grasp/release event with the errand's outcome unchanged. Vitest: exactly-once grasp/release, continuous prop world position, no segment-length change, cancellation before and after the grasp; pick-up sheet; in-game jar at contact, lift and crown.

VERIFIED: the shovel carry blends the right arm alone (gltfClipLayers.ts:160-172) over a carry clip derived from the hunched walk (toolclips.py:366-398), and the head-load steadying hand is solved BEFORE the clip layers move the pelvis (skinnedFigure.tsx:456-486 vs :508). KEPT: small load-specific additive poses (hand jar, head load, shovel) over the normalised walk or UAL2 Walk_Carry_Loop (A24's carry source lands here), the free arm's swing preserved, head oscillation reduced under a head load (U10's tightened gaze), modest load-dependent cadence, step width and balance offsets kept restrained, and the steadying or support hand solved against the FINAL crown or prop frame after locomotion and gaze (U9 order). Verification: grip error over complete strides, turns and speed changes; crown attachment and garment clearance; carry sheets and in-game pictures per load type.
